name: showreel-c3-event-poster

voice.text: When is this event? You can't tell. Turns out, related things sit together. Fix one: date and time together. Fix two: the place right under. Fix three: space between groups. Found it in a second.

caption:
When is this event? You can't tell. 🏮

1. Date and time together, in one block. Things placed close together are read as one group.
2. The place right under it. When, then where: one look answers both.
3. Space between groups. Extra space tells the eye where one group ends and the next begins.

Save this for your next poster, flyer or event post. What do you look for first on a poster?
